### Written Instructions
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-apr-18-2008-11573644.html
Passage: Exodus 19:16
Points:
- God called Moses to the mountain to establish a healthy and reverent fear among the people.
- The Sinai encounter marked the historic beginning of God delivering His written Word.
- Modern believers frequently take having the written Scriptures for granted.
- Possessing and holding God's complete revelation is an astonishing privilege that demands deep gratitude.

### At the Foot of Sinai
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/foot-sinai
Passage: Exodus 19:18
Points:
- God descended upon Sinai in fire and smoke to remind Israel of His sovereign power and majesty.
- The boundaries placed around the shaking mountain emphasized God's holiness and the people's need for purification.
- The thick smoke demonstrated that God concealed His full glory, revealing only what His people needed to know.
- Mature faith trusts God with unanswered questions and avoids speculative curiosity beyond what Scripture discloses.
